components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When present it is
            used to compose the salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: MR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional; still accepted for
            backward compatibility, and on read returns the composed structured
            address when structured fields are supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. When present (non-blank)
            it is preferred over the flat 'address' input and normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address; when present it
            is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must then contain exactly 10
            digits; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[^0-9]*([0-9][^0-9]*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present, the owner's ageBand is
            derived from it. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be a valid
            4-digit code within the range of the city's region (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit code. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allow this owner even though another owner has
            the same last name and address because they knowingly share a
            household. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'MR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's upper-cased first-name and last-name initials, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, assigned on creation as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date falls in,
                as 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, derived as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registration-date fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who knowingly share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on creation when 'sharesHousehold'
                is true and a matching owner already exists.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent).
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches.
              type: string
              example: '61412345678||a1b2c3d4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) immediately before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When present it is
            used to compose the salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: MR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional; still accepted for
            backward compatibility, and on read returns the composed structured
            address when structured fields are supplied.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. When present (non-blank)
            it is preferred over the flat 'address' input and normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address; when present it
            is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must then contain exactly 10
            digits; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[^0-9]*([0-9][^0-9]*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present, the owner's ageBand is
            derived from it. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be a valid
            4-digit code within the range of the city's region (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit code. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allow this owner even though another owner has
            the same last name and address because they knowingly share a
            household. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'MR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's upper-cased first-name and last-name initials, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region
                code, the two-digit registration-date fiscal year, the first eight upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn check
                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D8'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date falls in,
                as 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, derived as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registration-date fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who knowingly share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on creation when 'sharesHousehold'
                is true and a matching owner already exists.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent).
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches.
              type: string
              example: '61412345678||a1b2c3d4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) immediately before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: 0 plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure over
                one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners were already created for this owner's
                registration date, flagging a bulk-signup day; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners, approaching the
                per-city hard limit of 50; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived as 'EMAIL' when an email
                is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate:
                'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was created despite sharing an existing owner's last
                name and postcode (with a different telephone), flagging a soft match; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: true
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on last name and postcode.
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment formed as '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more else 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD) else 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical self link, formed as '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}: the
                record is retained but flagged and excluded from the create endpoint's
                duplicate/identity checks. False for a newly created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
